resources.string: Beta uses AccessibilityService only with your permission. It reads supported grocery app screens, helps build the cart you ask for, and stops before payment so you can review and continue yourself.
A simple helper for grocery orders. Large text, one clear start button, and easy guidance for setup.
Start screen capture and setup Beta
This begins the setup for screen reading and cart help.
Turn on Accessibility for Beta so it can read the grocery app screen.
Allow overlay permission if Android asks, so Beta can show its controls.
Allow screen capture when asked, so Beta can see the page you are on.
Allow microphone access only if you want to use voice orders.
What Beta will and will not do
Beta stops at the cart. It does not place the final order or make payment. You stay in control and can stop or continue manually at any time.
Start Beta first, then use voice order
Microphone permission is required for voice orders
Tell us what worked or where it got stuck
Before Beta helps in another app

Beta uses screen capture and AccessibilityService only after you choose to start. It reads supported grocery app screens, helps build the cart you request, and stops before payment. You can continue manually whenever you want. Diagnostic feedback is optional.
Beta needs Accessibility permission before it can help in Blinkit. Android will open Settings. Choose Beta, turn it on, then come back and press the start button again.
